examples.name: Sample — leader lines with two values at the end
paragraphs: A court directory: each person's line runs a dot leader to an e-mail address in grey and a phone number at the margin. Some lines have no e-mail, so the leader runs straight to the number. This is text, not a table: one line per person, leaders removed, the values separated by spaces. The grey of the e-mail addresses is decoration and is not carried. Heading depths are relative: the page does not show where CALDRIVANE COUNTY sits in the whole directory.
